rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an umbrella, whether used against rain or sun.

example.english: I remember to bring an umbrella when I go out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a rain umbrella rather than a sun parasol.

example.english: It’s raining, so remember to bring an umbrella.
example.jyutping: lok6 gan2 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 ze1

rows.note: Use this for the sun-protection slice of the sense, especially a parasol or sun umbrella.

example.english: It’s so sunny, bring an umbrella.
example.traditional: 天氣咁曬，帶把太陽傘啦。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 saai3 daai3 baa2 taai3 joeng4 saan3 laa1
